## `CustomerRegistryResource.java`

**File:** `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/CustomerRegistryResource.java`
**Base path:** `@Path("/customer-registry")`

### Customer Endpoints

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Description |
|--------|------|--------------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/customer-registry/customers` | `listCustomers` | List all customers |
| `GET` | `/customer-registry/customers/{customerId}` | `getCustomer` | Get customer by ID (404 if missing) |
| `PUT` | `/customer-registry/customers/{customerId}` | `upsertCustomer` | Create or update a customer |
| `DELETE` | `/customer-registry/customers/{customerId}` | `deleteCustomer` | Delete customer and all its products |

### Product Endpoints

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Description |
|--------|------|--------------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/customer-registry/customers/{customerId}/products` | `listProducts` | List products for a customer |
| `GET` | `/customer-registry/products/{productId}` | `getProduct` | Get product by ID |
| `PUT` | `/customer-registry/products/{productId}` | `upsertProduct` | Create or update a product |
| `DELETE` | `/customer-registry/products/{productId}` | `deleteProduct` | Delete a product |
| `PUT` | `/customer-registry/products/{productId}/teams` | `updateProductTeams` | Patch teams config on existing product |
| `PUT` | `/customer-registry/products/{productId}/environments` | `updateProductEnvironments` | Patch environments on existing product |

### Inner Request Records (defined in the resource class)

**`UpsertCustomerRequest`**
```
name        String              (required)
metadata    Map<String, Object> (optional)
```

**`UpsertProductRequest`**
```
customerId    String                           (required)
displayName   String                           (required)
git           GitConfig                        (optional)
jira          JiraProjectConfig                (optional)
confluence    ConfluenceProductConfig          (optional)
environments  List<EnvironmentConfig>          (optional)
teams         Map<String, List<TeamMember>>    (optional)
metadata      Map<String, Object>              (optional)
```

**`UpdateTeamsRequest`**
```
teams    Map<String, List<TeamMember>>    (required)
```

**`UpdateEnvironmentsRequest`**
```
environments    List<EnvironmentConfig>    (required)
```

---

## Model Records

### `CustomerConfig`
```
customerId    String              (required) — unique slug, e.g. "acme-corp"
name          String              (required) — display name
metadata      Map<String, Object> (optional)
createdAt     Instant             (readOnly)
updatedAt     Instant             (readOnly)
```

### `ProductConfig`
```
productId     String                         (required)
customerId    String                         (required)
displayName   String                         (required)
git           GitConfig                      (optional)
jira          JiraProjectConfig              (optional)
confluence    ConfluenceProductConfig        (optional)
environments  List<EnvironmentConfig>        (optional)
teams         Map<String, List<TeamMember>>  (optional) — role keys: productOwner, engineering, devops, operations, qa, security, supportQueue
metadata      Map<String, Object>            (optional)
createdAt     Instant                        (readOnly)
updatedAt     Instant                        (readOnly)
```

### `GitConfig`
```
platform    String    — enum: "bitbucket" | "github" | "gitlab" | "azuredevops"
workspace   String    — workspace or org slug
baseUrl     String    — only for self-hosted; omit for cloud
```

### `JiraProjectConfig`
```
baseUrl     String              — Jira base URL; falls back to global setting if blank
projects    Map<String, String> — project keys by role (e.g. {"serviceDesk":"SD","engineering":"ENG","devops":"OPS"})
```

### `ConfluenceProductConfig`
```
spaceKey      String    — Confluence space key (e.g. "MYPRODUCT")
rootPageId    String    — root page ID for the product's docs (e.g. "123456")
```

### `EnvironmentConfig`
```
name           String          — e.g. "acceptance", "production"
aws            AwsConfig       — AWS account/region for this environment
deployedRepos  List<String>    — repository slugs deployed in this environment
```

### `AwsConfig`
```
accountId    String    — AWS account ID (e.g. "123456789012")
region       String    — AWS region (e.g. "eu-central-1")
iamRole      String    — IAM role ARN the agent may assume for read-only access
```

### `TeamMember`
```
name           String    — full name
email          String    — work email
jiraAccountId  String    — Jira account ID for @mentions
slackId        String    — Slack member ID
```

---

**Key notes for the UI:**
- The `teams` field on `ProductConfig` / `UpsertProductRequest` is `Map<String, List<TeamMember>>` — the map keys are role names (`productOwner`, `engineering`, `devops`, `operations`, `qa`, `security`, `supportQueue`)
- `upsertCustomer` constructs `CustomerConfig` with `null` for both `products` and timestamps; the store handles timestamps
- The `PUT /products/{productId}` endpoint requires both `customerId` and `displayName` in the body, not inferred from path
- `PUT /products/{productId}/teams` and `PUT /products/{productId}/environments` are partial-update endpoints — they patch only those sub-fields and preserve everything else
